notes:
- Many tabs in a narrow window: tabs get narrower, then the tab bar scrolls with the mouse wheel (faded edges show there are more), the active tab stays in view, and "▾ N" lists all tabs with search
- Drag anything from the sidebar onto the tab bar – Quick access, your groups, Recent, Search, Plan… – onto a tab to open it there, or onto the empty bar for a new tab
- Customize sidebar: delete your own group with the trash icon (with Undo)
